notes: Obsidian Glint updated to 1.3.1. It now sets its own shadow colour, status colours, label casing and the styling for missing values — all things the app decided for it until this week.
It also stopped defining layout it does not own: 72 of those instructions are gone, and the theme chooser's grid is left to the app, which is what broke the Appearance tab yesterday.

The import check that re-applies our own fixes to an incoming theme had two tests that could never pass — they looked for a comment only we write, so they would have kept adding rules this theme already had. They now test the styling…
